To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have used surface specific vibrational (SSVS) spectroscopy to characterize the interaction of α-Al2O(0001) with water.

the interaction of water with the α-Al2O(0001) is characterized by the following: 1) The formation of a single water monolayer, 2) The formation of surface reconstruction, 3) The formation of two types of OH bonds with the Al surface, 4) The formation of Al-O vibrations that are surface phonon modes.

the interaction of water with the α-Al2O(0001) (sapphire) surface is characterized by a combination of surface phonon and O-H spectral changes that can be used to monitor the extent of dehydroxylation/reconstruction and the population of interfacial water molecules.
